description: The image displays two pie charts, “All Changes” and “All Errors,” each segmented into five categories represented by distinct colors and labeled with their respective percentages. The “All Changes” chart shows a large green segment at 50%, a pale yellow segment at 26%, a mustard-yellow segment at 14%, a small dark green segment at 4%, a light blue segment at 1%, and a medium blue segment at 5%. The “All Errors” chart features a large green segment at 56%, a pale yellow segment at 29%, a mustard-yellow segment at 6%, a small dark green segment at 3%, a light blue segment at 1%, and a medium blue segment at 5%. A legend on the right correlates the colors with the categories: light green for “PW,” dark green for “PW” (appearing to be a duplicate or mislabeling), pale yellow for “R,” mustard-yellow for “RW,” light blue for “N,” and medium blue for “NW.” Both charts include percentage labels directly on or near their corresponding slices, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size from the largest to the smallest, with the largest segment (green) positioned at the top right. There is no visual emphasis such as exploded slices or bolded text, and the charts are presented side by side for direct comparison.
